reviews.name: Tharindu Silva
reviews.message: The site visit was well organised and the land is ready to build. Happy to recommend Field Breeze.

reviews.name: Saman Jayawardena
reviews.message: Visited the site last weekend. Road access is excellent and the paddy-field view is exactly as advertised. Would like confirmation on the reservation process.

reviews.name: Nadeesha Perera
reviews.message: Clear deeds and the sales team explained bank-loan options well. Waiting on a second site visit before we decide.

reviews.name: Ruwan Fernando
reviews.message: Plot sizes matched the brochure and three-phase electricity is already on site. Smooth visit overall.

reviews.name: Ishara Silva
reviews.message: Location is convenient but the access road was muddy after rain. Sharing so the team can follow up.

reviews.name: Chamari Wickramasinghe
reviews.message: This review looks promotional and does not describe a real visit.

reviews.name: Kasun Bandara
reviews.message: Family-friendly neighbourhood and close to Divulapitiya town. We reserved a 10 perch plot.
